hero.label: OCDMANTRA
hero.title: What is OCD?
hero.subtitle: Understand what OCD is, how it can show up, and why it can feel so convincing.

video.title: Watch this short introduction to OCD.

basics.headline: OCD is more than unwanted thoughts.
basics.obsession_desc: Unwanted thoughts, images, doubts, or urges that can feel difficult to dismiss.
basics.compulsion_desc: Actions or mental responses you feel driven to repeat to reduce discomfort or feel certain.

themes.headline: OCD can take many forms.
themes.subtext: These are common themes, not separate diagnoses. One person can experience more than one.

contamination.name: Contamination
contamination.desc: Fears about germs, illness, dirt, or contamination.

harm.name: Harm
harm.desc: Unwanted fears about causing or being responsible for harm.

checking.name: Checking
checking.desc: Repeatedly checking safety, mistakes, doors, appliances, or other concerns.

symmetry.name: Symmetry & "Just Right"
symmetry.desc: Feeling that things need to be balanced, exact, or just right.

taboo.name: Intrusive / Taboo Thoughts
taboo.desc: Unwanted thoughts involving sexual, religious, aggressive, or other taboo themes.

responsibility.name: Responsibility & Doubt
responsibility.desc: Persistent doubt about mistakes, responsibility, or whether something is truly certain.

relatable.headline: OCD can make uncertainty feel impossible to leave alone.

example_2.thought: “What if I made a terrible mistake?”

takeaway.quote:
Everyone gets unwanted thoughts.

OCD can make those thoughts feel like something you have to solve.
takeaway.sub: Understanding that pattern is an important first step.

next_step.headline: Now let's look at how the OCD cycle can keep repeating.
